# MechanismFigures

> An agent skill for figures that show how a system works. Strong bias for rendered 3D.

- [Skill entry](SKILL.md): the loop
- [The fifteen moves](references/moves.md)
- [Craft](references/craft.md), [Truth](references/truth.md), [Critique](references/critique.md)
- [Clarity and cinematic flow](references/story.md)
- [The 3D stage](references/stage.md)
- [Atlas of published figures](references/atlas.md)
- [Install](docs/INSTALL.md)

No model call, no network at run time. All atlas images are published figures.
